Sanjeev AI: Features & Use Cases ​

This document outlines the core features, capabilities, and primary use cases of the Sanjeev AI platform.

Core Features ​

1. The Unified Studio ​

The core editing and generation interface where users bring their scripts to life.

  • Script Management & Timeline Editor: Write or upload scripts (TXT, MD, Fountain), which are tracked and chunked into manageable scenes and lines on an interactive timeline.
  • Character Manager (The "Cast"): Assign distinct voice profiles (WaveNet, Standard, Neural2, or Gemini) to different characters or speakers within the script.
  • Audio Generation (TTS): Seamlessly convert script lines into high-quality audio clips using advanced Text-to-Speech engines via Google Cloud.
  • AI Visual Director: Automatically generate prompts and visual scenes (images or video clips) for each segment of the script using GenAI (e.g., Vertex AI / Veo).
  • Hybrid Video Export (Cinema Mode): Stitch together the generated audio and visual scenes into a final, downloadable video artifact. Users can choose between a zero-cost local Canvas render, or a premium Cloud Render (up to 1080p using FFmpeg) that runs in the background.

2. In-App Notification System ​

A global inbox designed to keep users informed about asynchronous tasks without requiring them to stay on the page.

  • Background Task Alerts: Receive real-time alerts when heavy background jobs (like Cloud Rendering) complete or fail.
  • Actionable Links: Notifications include deep links that take the user directly back to the relevant project or exported video.

2. Advanced YouTube Integration & Publishing ​

A complete, robust pipeline for managing YouTube content directly from the Studio.

  • Bulletproof Authentication: Secure OAuth integration featuring an auto-renewing backend engine that silently refreshes expired Google tokens, ensuring uninterrupted workflows.
  • Direct Video Publishing: Stream fully rendered, heavy video files directly from Google Cloud Storage to YouTube to prevent memory crashes, complete with dynamic progress tracking.
  • Standalone Metadata Syncing: A smart Dual-Mode Publish UI that allows users to seamlessly update titles, descriptions, tags, and privacy settings for live videos without having to re-upload the video file.
  • Custom Thumbnail Lab: Auto-generate click-optimized prompts based on video metadata, generate 16:9 cinematic thumbnails using Vertex AI (Imagen 4), and push them instantly to the YouTube video.
  • Intelligent Playlist Management: Automatically creates YouTube Playlists for new projects. Features a dedicated Project Settings modal to live-sync project titles and descriptions directly to the YouTube API, complete with one-click "View Playlist" dashboard access. Playlist cover art automatically inherits the custom AI-generated thumbnails from the uploaded episodes.

3. Project & Workflow Management ​

  • Project Workspaces: Organize scripts, video drafts, and media assets into distinct, isolated projects.
  • Enhanced Dashboard UX: Responsive, wrap-safe UI designs that gracefully handle complex project names and metadata without breaking the workspace layout.
  • Automated Workflows: Define and execute multi-step orchestrations (e.g., automatically generating audio for all lines sequentially based on defined step objects).

4. Billing & Usage Tracking ​

  • Usage Dashboard: Granular tracking of platform usage for billing purposes.
  • Tracked Metrics: Includes TTS characters processed (across different engine tiers), GenAI input/output tokens used, and total storage bytes added per month.

5. Support Readiness & Observability ​

A robust observability layer ensuring platform reliability and supportability.

  • Client-Side Error Logging: Automatically captures unhandled exceptions, network timeouts, and failed media generations, piping structured logs directly into Google Cloud Logging for proactive support and debugging.

Primary Use Cases ​

1. Faceless YouTube Channel Automation ​

Content creators can use Sanjeev AI as an end-to-end pipeline to run "faceless" YouTube channels. Workflow: Upload a script ➡️ Generate TTS audio ➡️ Let the AI Director generate matching visual scenes ➡️ Export video ➡️ Auto-publish to a synced YouTube Playlist ➡️ Generate and push a custom AI thumbnail.

2. YouTube SEO & Content Optimization ​

Instead of navigating the complex YouTube Studio dashboard, marketers can use Sanjeev AI to A/B test their live content. They can tweak video descriptions, adjust tags, and generate fresh, highly relevant AI thumbnails to improve click-through rates, syncing the changes to live videos instantly.

3. Automated Audiobook & Podcast Creation ​

Authors and publishers can upload their manuscripts or podcast scripts, assign specific unique voices to different characters/hosts, and generate fully dramatized audio chapters with minimal manual audio editing.

4. Rapid Storyboarding & Prototyping ​

Filmmakers, animators, and marketers can use the Unified Studio to rapidly prototype video concepts. By typing a script and running the AI Director, they receive a visual and auditory storyboard in minutes to preview pacing, aesthetics, and overall vibe.

5. Multilingual Content Generation ​

By leveraging customizable character maps and workflows, users can quickly generate localized variations of the same video or audio content in multiple languages or dialects without needing to hire native-speaking voice actors for every iteration.
